name: conditional_staleness
claim: A met condition guarantees the action runs while it still holds
detail: Condition 'block <= 11392654' evaluated true at block 11392654; the action was included at block 11392655, 1 block(s) later, where it is false. KeeperHub's own read-condition-act primitive carries the gap it exists to remove: the check and the action are not atomic, so the gate says 'only act while true' and delivers 'act if it was true a moment ago'. An agent that hand-rolls this at least knows it is racing.
